checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 854x480 (16:9); frames sampled up to 9.5s of 10s.

must.item: Lonely bus stop at night with wet surfaces
must.why: Empty shelter on a wet, reflective street under an amber streetlight.

must.item: Subdued lighting, unhurried melancholy peaceful mood
must.why: Dark blue/amber palette, empty street, slow feel; slightly moody but not suspenseful.
Slow push-in is clear across frames (shelter grows); drips/rain visible.

must.item: Silent, no titles, captions or dialogue
must.why: No on-screen text or captions visible; audio cannot be verified from stills, though stated silent.

faults.what: Shelter looks more like an open canopy on poles than a typical bus stop; no bench or sign, so bus stop identity is a bit weak.
Appears to be active rain/drizzle falling under the roof rather than just after rain.
Faint illegible signage on the left building; tiny and not readable.

summary: A coherent, atmospheric empty wet-street night scene with an amber streetlight and a slow push-in, though the canopy reads only loosely as a bus stop and it looks like it is still drizzling.
